definitions.explanation: A document listing one's employment history, job responsibilities, and professional experience. In Japanese job hunting, this is typically submitted alongside a {履歴書|りれきしょ} (personal history form).

examples.japanese: {職歴書|しょくれきしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
⟦{面接|めんせつ}→面接：01100_mensetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{職歴書|しょくれきしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持参|じさん}して→持参する：21143_jisansuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please bring your resume to the interview.

examples.japanese: ⟦{転職|てんしょく}→転職：04557_tenshoku⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{履歴書|りれきしょ}→履歴書：04691_rirekisho⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{職歴書|しょくれきしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{両方|りょうほう}→両方：01750_ryouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}する→準備する：22427_junbisuru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: When job hunting, you need to prepare both a personal history form and a work history document.

examples.japanese: {職歴書|しょくれきしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{業務|ぎょうむ}→業務：09630_gyoumu⟧⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{実績|じっせき}→実績：04214_jisseki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{具体的|ぐたいてき}→具体的：04781_gutaiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{記載|きさい}→記載：14169_kisai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In a resume, you describe your past job duties and accomplishments in concrete terms.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{職歴|しょくれき}→職歴：17959_shokureki⟧ (work history) + ⟦{書|しょ}→〜書：28467_sho⟧ (document). The more formal, complete name is ⟦{職務|しょくむ}{経歴書|けいれきしょ}→職務経歴書：08724_shokumukeirekisho⟧, which is the standard term used in Japanese job applications. {職歴書|しょくれきしょ} is the commonly shortened form.

In Japanese job hunting, applicants typically submit two documents: a ⟦{履歴書|りれきしょ}→履歴書：04691_rirekisho⟧ (standardized personal data form with photo, education, and basic work history) and a ⟦{職務|しょくむ}{経歴書|けいれきしょ}→職務経歴書：08724_shokumukeirekisho⟧ (detailed description of professional experience and accomplishments).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {職歴書|しょくれきしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作成|さくせい}する→作成する：25378_sakuseisuru⟧: to prepare a resume
- {職歴書|しょくれきしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧: to submit a resume
- {職歴書|しょくれきしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{書|か}き{方|かた}→書き方：13054_kakikata⟧: how to write a resume

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{履歴書|りれきしょ}→履歴書：04691_rirekisho⟧: personal history form — the standardized Japanese form with photo, education, and personal details
- ⟦{職務|しょくむ}{経歴書|けいれきしょ}→職務経歴書：08724_shokumukeirekisho⟧: detailed work history — the full formal name for this document
- レジュメ: resume — loanword, sometimes used in international or casual contexts
